findings.speaker: Dr. Hannibal Lecter
findings.text: Your annual review is complete. A triumph for both coordination and administrative persistence.

findings.speaker: DETECTIVE
findings.text: I am also following up John's transport. Does his earlier agency medical record add anything?

findings.speaker: Dr. Hannibal Lecter
findings.text: The earlier clinical summary records treatment for poisoning and a gunshot wound. Both entries predate that transport flight.

findings.speaker: DETECTIVE
findings.text: So those were not injuries caused by the aircraft hitting the ground.

findings.speaker: Dr. Hannibal Lecter
findings.text: Correct. The dates separate the events. They do not identify who was responsible or tell you why it happened.

findings.speaker: Dr. Hannibal Lecter
findings.text: Do not diagnose a culprit from a treatment entry. Even this agency has limits on creative paperwork.

objective: Complete agency mission ten, then examine the financial trail using the records Holly supplies.

messages.ready: Annual medical review is available on the upper floor.
messages.complete: Medical review completed. John's poisoning and gunshot treatment predate the flight. Next: mission ten, then the financial trail.
